artifact_contract: Upload contents of out/<job>/; download each dependency contents into in/<job>/. For resume restore the entire training output directory, including best checkpoints.
environment: Python 3.12, torch 2.14.1 CPU, numpy, scipy preinstalled; no downloads by these commands
generation_budget: Four 1800-second jobs = 2 CPU hours. Quota deficits and layer counts must be read from summary.json; never silently fill with duplicates.

jobs.name: train_60101
